title: Rishi Deo Pande v. State of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Rishi Deo Pande v. State of U.P., AIR 1955 SC 331
content.holding: Reaffirmed that common intention can develop during the course of the occurrence on the spur of the moment, to be inferred from the conduct of the assailants, nature of weapons, and coordination of attack.
